name: Hiiragizaka no Kyuukan
source:
Hero is a freelance writer. Because he has asthma, he visits a hot springs resort and stays at a small ryokan. A relaxed atmosphere governs here, but one day a dead body is found at the resort. The corpse is dried of liquid. Hero is interested in the incident and starts his own investigation. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名自由撰稿人。由于患有哮喘，他前往温泉度假地，住进一家小旅馆。此地氛围悠闲，某天却在度假地发现了一具尸体，体内液体已经完全干涸。主人公对事件产生兴趣，开始自行调查。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
